"""Capture native construction and an independent Polars construction oracle."""
import json
import runpy
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from importlib.metadata import version
from pathlib import Path

import ibis
import polars as pl

from mountainash.core.capabilities.schema import ExternalEntrypointTarget

root = Path("/home/ubuntu/git/mountainash-io/mountainash-central/04.planning/mountainash/superpowers/plans")
candidate_path = root / "2026-09-15-manifestation-relation-candidates.py"
candidate_source = candidate_path.read_text()
candidates = runpy.run_path(str(candidate_path))
connections = {"ibis-duckdb": ibis.duckdb.connect(), "ibis-sqlite": ibis.sqlite.connect(":memory:")}
observations = []
for row in candidates["_ROWS"]:
    legacy, scope, target, scenario_id, payload, *_ = row
    if type(target) is not ExternalEntrypointTarget:
        continue
    data = payload["arguments"]["obj"]
    options = payload["options"]
    # Independent oracle: actual native Polars construction with identical input.
    oracle = pl.DataFrame(data)
    expected = {"status": "constructed", "rows": oracle.to_dicts(),
                "schema": {name: str(dtype) for name, dtype in oracle.schema.items()}}
    conn = connections[scope.dialect]
    # Observer: native Ibis table construction only, not Mountainash or execute().
    try:
        table = conn.create_table(options["name"], data, overwrite=options["overwrite"])
        observed = {"status": "constructed", "schema": {name: str(dtype) for name, dtype in table.schema().items()}}
    except Exception as exc:
        observed = {"status": "raised", "exception": f"{type(exc).__module__}.{type(exc).__qualname__}",
                    "message": str(exc)}
    observations.append({"legacy_ref": legacy, "scenario_id": scenario_id,
                         "scope": scope.dialect, "entrypoint": [target.entrypoint.module, target.entrypoint.qualname],
                         "stage": "construction", "layer": "native", "input_data": data,
                         "options": options, "oracle": expected, "observed": observed,
                         "mountainash_entrypoint_called": False})
report = {
    "captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "packages": {name: version(name) for name in ("ibis-framework", "polars", "duckdb", "pandas", "pyarrow")},
    "engines": {scope: conn.version for scope, conn in connections.items()},
    "observations": observations,
    "probe_source": Path(__file__).read_text(),
    "candidate_source": candidate_source,
    "boundary": "Direct native construction only. Polars oracle uses identical data. No Mountainash operation or Ibis materialization invoked.",
}
output = root / "2026-09-15-external-native-construction-observations.json"
output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
for observation in observations:
    print(observation["scope"], observation["scenario_id"], observation["observed"])
print("Retained complete native observations:", output)
